sn11.14:1.1: ekaṃ samayaṃ bhagavā rājagahe viharati veḷuvane kalandakanivāpe.
sn11.14:2.1: bhūtapubbaṃ bhikkhave aññataro puriso imasmiṃyeva rājagahe manussadaḷiddo ahosi manussakapaṇo manussavarāko.
sn11.14:2.2: so tathāgatappavedite dhammavinaye saddhaṃ samādiyi sīlaṃ samādiyi sutaṃ samādiyi cāgaṃ samādiyi paññaṃ samādiyi.
sn11.14:2.3: so tathāgatappavedite dhammavinaye saddhaṃ samādiyitvā sīlaṃ samādiyitvā sutaṃ samādiyitvā cāgaṃ samādiyitvā paññaṃ samādiyitvā kāyassa bhedā parammaraṇā sugatiṃ saggaṃ lokaṃ upapajji devānaṃ tāvatiṃsānaṃ sahabyataṃ.
sn11.14:2.4: so aññe deve atirocati vaṇṇena ceva yasasā ca.
sn11.14:2.5: tatra sudaṃ bhikkhave devā tāvatiṃsā ujjhāyanti khīyanti vipācenti
sn11.14:2.6: acchariyaṃ vata bho abbhūtaṃ vata bho
sn11.14:2.7: ayaṃ hi devaputto pubbe manussabhūto samāno manussadaḷiddo ahosi manussakapaṇo manussavarāko
sn11.14:2.8: so kāyassa bhedā parammaraṇā sugatiṃ saggaṃ lokaṃ upapanno devānaṃ tāvatiṃsānaṃ sahabyataṃ
sn11.14:2.9: so aññe deve atirocati vaṇṇena ceva yasasā cāti.
sn11.14:3.1: atha kho bhikkhave sakko devānamindo deve tāvatiṃse āmantesi
sn11.14:3.2: mā kho tumhe mārisā etassa devaputtassa ujjhāyittha
sn11.14:3.3: eso kho mārisā devaputto pubbe manussabhūto samāno tathāgatappavedite dhammavinaye saddhaṃ samādiyi sīlaṃ samādiyi sutaṃ samādiyi cāgaṃ samādiyi paññaṃ samādiyi
sn11.14:3.4: so tathāgatappavedite dhammavinaye saddhaṃ samādiyitvā sīlaṃ samādiyitvā sutaṃ samādiyitvā cāgaṃ samādiyitvā paññaṃ samādiyitvā kāyassa bhedā parammaraṇā sugatiṃ saggaṃ lokaṃ upapanno devānaṃ tāvatiṃsānaṃ sahabyataṃ
sn11.14:3.5: so aññe deve atirocati vaṇṇena ceva yasasā cāti.
sn11.14:3.6: atha kho bhikkhave sakko devānamindo deve tāvatiṃse anunayamāno tāyaṃ velāyaṃ imā gāthāyo abhāsi
